content: For high-skepticism customers, never stop at a partial demonstration. If they worry about OTP on their own network, use their own phone number to send a real OTP during the demo, or use a store SIM to simulate the exact flow.
When a customer asks to 'think overnight,' do not simply agree. Propose a specific time to follow up, or create urgency with a limited-time bundle offer to encourage same-day decision.
Personal guarantees are weak against concrete proof. Always prioritize showing over telling, especially for trust-sensitive objections like banking app reliability.
In in-store scenarios, leverage the physical environment to perform end-to-end tests that cannot be replicated online. This builds trust faster than any verbal assurance.

name: End-to-End Scenario Simulation
condition: When customer doubts a specific function (e.g., OTP, app compatibility) in their real-life context.
example: Use the customer's own phone number to send a real OTP during the demo, simulating the exact rent payment scenario.

name: Urgency Anchoring with Limited Offer
condition: When customer hesitates and asks for time to think.
example: Mention a time-limited bundle or promotion that expires today, then propose a specific follow-up time to secure the deal.

name: Live Proof Chain
condition: When customer repeatedly questions the same feature after seeing a demo.
example: Progressively escalate the proof: from opening the app → showing a test notification → sending a real OTP to the customer's phone → letting the customer perform the action themselves.

objection: Will OTP work on my own network when rent is due?
rebuttal_template: I understand your concern. Let's do this: give me your phone number, and I'll send a test OTP from Vietcombank right now on this demo unit. You'll see it arrive instantly on your phone. If it doesn't, I'll personally ensure your satisfaction. Ready to try?

objection: I need to think one night.
rebuttal_template: I completely understand. However, the bundle we discussed is part of a limited promotion that ends today. If you decide tonight, I can hold it for you until tomorrow morning. How about I call you at 9 AM to confirm? That way you don't miss out.

objection: Will it really get OTP SMS instantly?
rebuttal_template: Let's prove it right now. I'll use this demo unit to request an OTP from Vietcombank using your phone number. Watch your phone—you'll see the SMS pop up within seconds. If there's any delay, we'll troubleshoot together. Shall we try?
